transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ChatGPT. What brings you in today?

Hi Doctor. I've been having a lot of trouble focusing and paying attention lately. I find myself constantly avoiding or putting off any tasks that require a lot of sustained mental effort because I just can't seem to face them.
Do you also often feel restless or unable to sit still, interrupt others, or act impulsively, or is it mainly problems with attention and procrastination?

It's definitely more about attention and procrastination rather than restlessness or impulsivity. I get easily distracted by external things or even my own unrelated thoughts, which makes me constantly avoid or put off tasks that require a lot of mental effort.
When did these attention and procrastination problems start, and did they begin after a specific stressful event or change in your life?

They've been particularly noticeable and difficult for the last year and five months, but I actually first experienced these struggles back in childhood, well before I was 12. I don't recall them starting after any specific stressful event or life change; they've just always been there.
Do these attention problems cause significant difficulties in more than one area of your life, such as school or work, home responsibilities, or relationships?

To be honest, I'm not really sure and I haven't thought about it in that way. I just know that avoiding these tasks is a big struggle for me, but I can't say for sure how it impacts all those different areas of my life.
Can you think of examples where these attention problems have clearly caused problems at school or work, at home, or in your relationships?

I'm really not sure and I can't recall any specific examples of these problems affecting my work, home life, or relationships right now. It is just a constant struggle for me to actually sit down and do those mentally demanding tasks.
Have these attention problems led to missed deadlines, poor grades or work performance, forgotten responsibilities, or other clear day-to-day mistakes?

I'm not entirely sure and I haven't really kept track of whether it has caused specific issues like missed deadlines or forgotten chores. I just know that my day-to-day is mostly consumed by the struggle of being easily distracted and trying to avoid those hard mental tasks.
Do you have trouble following through on tasks, organizing your work or belongings, or remembering appointments and routine responsibilities?

I don't think I really have those specific issues with organizing my things or remembering appointments. I'm not entirely sure about following through on tasks, but my main struggle is just avoiding starting them in the first place.
Do you often make careless mistakes, lose track of details, or seem not to listen when someone is speaking directly to you?

I don't think I really struggle with making careless mistakes or losing track of details. I'm also not really sure about seeming like I'm not listening, as that's not something I've noticed happening.
Do you often forget things like appointments, chores, or where you put important items, even when you try to keep track of them?
No, I don't really struggle with forgetting appointments or losing important items. I'm usually able to keep track of those things without much trouble.
Besides difficulty starting mentally demanding tasks, do you have several other attention symptoms often enough that they cause problems in daily life?

Yes, I definitely struggle with being very easily distracted by things going on around me, or even just by my own unrelated thoughts. It happens so frequently that it makes it really difficult to stay focused on what I'm supposed to be doing.
